concept.name: Tiny Victory Department
concept.audience: office workers, remote workers, students and everyday gift buyers
concept.theme: playful everyday encouragement with faux-corporate visual language
concept.visual: Original cheerful bureaucratic seal: small rising sun, three tiny stars, simple laurel-like abstract marks, imperfect hand-inked linework; no logos, characters, brands or copied artwork.
concept.style: warm retro office ephemera, whimsical handmade feel, bold readable typography, limited flat ink palette, transparent background
concept.placement: large centered wrap-safe front graphic; must remain readable at mug viewing distance

researchSignals: Etsy 2026 trend reporting shows demand for whimsy/playful self-expression
Etsy 2026 trend reporting shows growth in small just-because gifts
Current Etsy mug results show humor, encouragement and giftability as active patterns

artworkSpec.targetPx: high-resolution master; exact Printify placement geometry to be derived from live blueprint before upload
